metadata.notes: Closing the remaining high-stakes gaps in the professional mesh.

nodes.title: Unreal Engine 5 Foundations
nodes.description: Mastery of Blueprints, Lumen, and Nanite. Real-time rendering and world-building. Linked to the 4D Cross-Section Visualizer track.

nodes.title: CIPP/US (Certified Information Privacy Professional)
nodes.description: Privacy laws, regulations, and standards. Mapping sovereign data ownership and ahimsa-based privacy to global legal frameworks.

nodes.title: HAZWOPER 40-Hour (Hazardous Waste Operations)
nodes.description: Safety training for workers involved in hazardous waste clean-up and emergency response. Linked to Planetary Repair and Bio-remediation.

nodes.title: AICP Urban Planning Fundamentals
nodes.description: Land use, transportation, infrastructure, and environmental planning. Bridging habitat engineering to professional municipal planning.

nodes.title: Certified DevSecOps Professional (CDP)
nodes.description: Integrating security into the DevOps lifecycle. Automated security testing, container security, and compliance. Linked to Mesh Immunity.

edges.rationale: High-dimensional vector mastery provides the mathematical foundation for real-time 3D engine physics.
Sovereign jurisprudence mastery covers the majority of US privacy law and ethical domains.
Planetary repair capstones provide the field-experience context for hazardous waste safety operations.
Eco-stewardship habitat design is the practical basis for sustainable municipal urban planning.
